portInfo.description: Visit Long Beach lists the Long Beach Cruise Terminal at 231 Windsor Way with Carnival contact (800) 764-7419 and describes the facility as owned and operated by Carnival Corporation alongside the Queen Mary. Port of Los Angeles passenger pages explicitly warn that Los Angeles and Long Beach are different ports with different seaport codes (US LAX vs US LGB). On-site parking structure rates and a 7'0" garage height limit are published by Visit Long Beach; oversized vehicles cannot use the garage. Berth LOA/draft maxima are **Not verified** on the tourism pages cited this pass.

thingsToDo.shortCall: Homeport embark days rarely leave long free time; if a port call, downtown loop with ≥75 min return buffer.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Aquarium + waterfront lunch; keep ≥90 min buffer for traffic back to Windsor Way.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Pre/post-cruise hotel nights in Long Beach as Visit Long Beach markets.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Double-check **US LGB vs US LAX** on your documents — rideshare to the wrong harbour wastes an embark morning.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Long Beach Cruise Terminal (231 Windsor Way) — Carnival-operated; door pin null
gettingThere.publicTransport: **Airports.** Visit Long Beach publishes driving guidance from LAX and LGB (details on their cruise pages). **Downtown.** Short ride to Pine Avenue / Shoreline Village; walk minutes from Windsor Way **Not verified**.
